import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import io

# Prepare the data
csv_data = """amount,is_fraud,transaction_type,hour_of_day
115.02,0,refund,22
44.37,0,payment,5
144.25,0,transfer,21
536.22,0,payment,17
38.43,0,payment,5
"""

df = pd.read_csv(io.StringIO(csv_data))

# Set a professional and modern aesthetic for the plots
sns.set_theme(style="whitegrid", rc={"axes.edgecolor": ".8", "grid.color": ".9"})

# Create a figure and axes for the plot
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(12, 8))

# Create the scatter plot
# This visualization is chosen to effectively display multiple dimensions of the data:
# - X-axis: Hour of the day (temporal dimension)
# - Y-axis: Transaction amount (magnitude)
# - Color: Transaction type (categorical dimension)
# - Size: Transaction amount (reinforces magnitude, making large transactions pop)
scatter = sns.scatterplot(
    data=df,
    x='hour_of_day',
    y='amount',
    hue='transaction_type',
    size='amount',
    sizes=(100, 1000),  # Emphasize the difference in transaction amounts
    palette='viridis',
    alpha=0.8,
    edgecolor='black',
    linewidth=1.2,
    ax=ax
)

# Add annotations for each point to provide exact values
for i in range(df.shape[0]):
    plt.text(
        x=df.hour_of_day[i] + 0.3,
        y=df.amount[i],
        s=f'${df.amount[i]:.2f}',
        fontdict=dict(color='black', size=10)
    )

# Set plot title and labels with enhanced formatting
ax.set_title('Analysis of Transaction Amount by Hour and Type', fontsize=18, fontweight='bold', pad=20)
ax.set_xlabel('Hour of Day', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold', labelpad=15)
ax.set_ylabel('Transaction Amount ($)', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold', labelpad=15)

# Customize ticks for better readability
ax.tick_params(axis='both', which='major', labelsize=12)
ax.set_xticks(range(0, 25, 2))  # Set x-axis ticks for every 2 hours
ax.get_yaxis().set_major_formatter(plt.FuncFormatter(lambda x, p: f'${int(x)}'))

# Improve the legend
handles, labels = scatter.get_legend_handles_labels()
# Separate hue and size legends for clarity
type_legend_count = len(df['transaction_type'].unique())
legend1 = ax.legend(handles[:type_legend_count+1], labels[:type_legend_count+1], title='Transaction Type',
                    bbox_to_anchor=(1.02, 1), loc='upper left', borderaxespad=0., fontsize=11, title_fontsize=13)
ax.add_artist(legend1) # Add the first legend back to the plot

# Adjust layout to make room for the legend
plt.tight_layout(rect=[0, 0, 0.85, 1])

# Save the final visualization to a file
plt.savefig('output.png', dpi=300, bbox_inches='tight')
